Hi, I'm Tim Fraticelli, a Physical Therapist and the founder of PTProgress. On this channel, you’ll learn about Physical Therapy career and treatment along with a few product reviews.  My mission is to inspire people to take action so I hope you find the videos to be helpful and be sure to subscribe for new videos each week!
Thanks for subscribing!
-Tim

After you subscribe, check this out:
Therapy Documentation: www.ptprogress.com/documentation
